description: This file defines the NoteRepository interface, extending JpaRepository to provide CRUD operations and custom search methods for the Note entity. It includes methods for searching by title or content with case-insensitive matching and filtering notes by tags, also case-insensitive, with support for pagination.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: A repository interface for Note entity providing CRUD and custom search methods, including case-insensitive search and tag filtering with pagination.

methods.name: findByTitleContainingIgnoreCaseOrContentContainingIgnoreCase
methods.description: Searches for notes where the title or content contains the given text, case-insensitive, with pagination.

methods.name: findByTagsContainingIgnoreCase
methods.description: Finds notes where the tags string contains the specified tag, case-insensitive, with pagination.
